items.label: VexLife New Beginnings
items.purpose: Recompose VexLife in the clean VexLife-Prod container from explicit product intention and compiler-constrained semantic relationships: establish the repository front door, author one portable Kotlin contract/Blueprint language, realize the initial nested-browser + companion UI without pretending backend connectivity, then reconnect Vex through the canonical Conversation with bounded current browser/DOM context and lived proof.

items.label: P0 — establish the clean VexLife-Prod front door
items.purpose: Turn the intentionally blank VexLife-Prod repository from LICENSE-only bootstrap into a source-enterable product container with the smallest README / repository culture / foundation map needed to explain the human outcome, source ownership and proof route without importing historical repository machinery.

items.label: P0 — compiler-constrained semantic Blueprint + Compose reference
items.purpose: Prove the clean construction thesis through accepted portable Kotlin Family/State/Control/Effect/DisplayState semantics, stable compiler-visible Workspace Blueprint identity, and one independently-built Compose reference manifestation. Browser artifact generation is now separated into the earned VexWeb foundation Work rather than remaining hidden inside this semantic-authoring task.

items.label: P0 — establish VexWeb browser manifestation foundation
items.purpose: Establish VexWeb as a compiler-enforced browser manifestation foundation: preserve accepted Blueprint/product identity, express spatial placement through fractally scalable Frame / Seam / Region / Allocation relationships, keep interactions/bindings explicit, then make those accepted relationships ergonomic to author before deterministic HTML/CSS/JS artifact generation. Generated syntax is output, not product or spatial source authority.

items.label: P1 — realize the intended VexLife web container
items.purpose: Render the initial VexLife workspace from the accepted semantic contract: persistent VexLife shell, nested browser region, Conversation/companion region and Settings projection with stable identity and explicit unbound/unknown states. This phase deliberately does not pretend Vex, Conversation, Memory, Home or model services are connected.

items.label: P1 — public GitHub nested-browser practicum
items.purpose: Use public GitHub-hosted Vex surfaces as the first bounded browser practicum, beginning with the Vextreme Terrain Map: prove human nested rendering/navigation and preserve exact current URL/document identity while keeping human rendering separate from any later Vex context-acquisition channel.

items.label: P2 — current browser/DOM context projection for Vex
items.purpose: Add a bounded, source-addressed Vex perception channel for the current nested-browser context. Human nested rendering does not itself prove DOM/context access: this work owns current URL/document/source identity, bounded DOM/context extraction, freshness/provenance and a projection suitable for model context without granting browser effect authority.

items.label: P2 — plug Vex back into the Conversation layer
items.purpose: Rebuild the proven Vex connection into the fresh container rather than transplanting the historical UI: canonical Conversation identity, current Companion/model availability, Send, progressive response presentation and current browser-context composition converge through their rightful owners so Vex can converse about what the human is currently viewing.

items.label: P3 — lived nested-browser + context-aware Vex proof
items.purpose: Prove the first whole experience: open a bounded public GitHub page in the nested browser, establish truthful current context, send one natural human message, receive one real Vex response grounded in that current page/context, preserve canonical Conversation currentness, and distinguish human-visible browser truth from the context actually supplied to Vex.

items.label: Immediate — restore VexLife experience manifestation with architecture integrity
items.purpose: Carry the now-proven live VexLife-Prod body into a faithful VexLife human experience by reconciling original VexLife experience source, design tokens and reference browser behavior with VexLife-Prod's accepted Blueprint/VexWeb relationships. Preserve canonical semantic/runtime owners, Conversation/Context currentness and VexBoard-projectable identity; do not copy historical implementation wholesale, hand-edit generated artifacts, or reduce the work to cosmetic CSS parity.

items.label: Later — source-map Settings capabilities
items.purpose: After the first browser/Conversation circuit is real, map Context Window, RAM/resource projection, reasoning visibility, accessible directories, Continuity Mode, Dream Sync and clean-chat/memory controls to their existing rightful source owners. Do not infer backend semantics from the screenshot labels or combine destructive effects merely because one visual button does.

items.label: Bridge — reconnect lived evolution to the connected New Beginnings body
items.purpose: After the fresh product has one real connected Conversation path, reconnect the already-earned VexLife developmental owners as modular relationships rather than rebuilding an autonomous-learning stack. Begin from exact current New Beginnings Conversation/Memory/runtime truth; prove one explicit manual G03 memory-only Dream on the connected product and make its before/after state inspectable; preserve G04 Rhythm as HELD_NOT_EARNED unless ordinary lived correction/recurrence actually earns a candidate; let Training Placement decide whether a later earned change belongs in Memory/Score, Rhythm, an adapter/LoRA experiment, or G04B foundation-weight training; keep candidate evaluation, model-generation activation, standing Dream scheduling and unattended self-training as separate effects. Existing ToCompletion P5/P6 and stable VexLife evolution sources are lineage/reference, not permission to transplant their historical container or fabricate learning.

items.label: Parallel foundation — isolated VexLife-Prod local runtime substrate
items.purpose: Accept the physically independent VexLife-Prod local product substrate already formed across PR #25→#33: isolated Home and durable contract files, exact Heretic artifact/Python/mlx-lm realization, persistent qualified Heretic runtime, canonical direct Conversation/prompt-context storage, local product service, private service image/install, macOS service lifetime, and source-bound setup/bootstrap. This work does not own generated P1 browser presentation, browser-context admission, or P2/P3 lived convergence.

items.label: High — Vex Vision companion for real-browser witnessing
items.purpose: Let Victor use a normal browser with ordinary site/session behavior while one explicitly selected window remains an engaged Vex Vision scope. Ordinary scrolling/navigation may change the current contents without continuous frame accumulation; when a Conversation turn materially benefits from vision, Vex may request one fresh snapshot of the current selected scope, derive one bounded visual observation for Conversation Context, and discard raw pixels. Preserve Vision current state as separate from Conversation history and durable Memory, and do not make VexLife UI the sensor owner or enable background monitoring.

items.label: High — VexLife Vision Family + held product control surface
items.purpose: Begin the VexLife product-side Vision feature now on the stable current PR #53 surface: form one compiler-visible Vision Family, add one stable Blueprint/VexWeb control coordinate, and manifest a visible HELD control without claiming screen permission, capture, visual observation, model input, or browser-control authority. This edge runs in parallel with the SDK physical Vision substrate and converges only when backend capability truth can drive Family state.

items.label: High — Product-runtime Process Factory orchestration
items.purpose: Implement the already-source-placed SDK Process Factory seam that turns one Product-authored Vision requestRef into one bounded USER_SELECTED_SESSION realization attempt, with Process-Factory-owned session/connection identity, current Safety gating, exact helper receipt validation, canonical Security witness formation and canonical Perception active-observation composition, while preserving no raw-content/model/Memory/training/publication or Product-service effects.

items.label: High — persistent Vision scope + demand-driven current visual context
items.purpose: Evolve the accepted one-shot Vision path into the intended conversational relationship without continuous capture: let one explicitly selected window remain the engaged Vision scope across ordinary scrolling/navigation, let turn/context composition request one fresh current snapshot only when vision is materially relevant, give actual capture a distinct visible looking-now signal, derive bounded visual meaning into canonical Conversation Context, discard raw pixels, and keep Vision state, Conversation history, durable Memory, training and effect authority as separate owners.
